text:
alex: Heads-up: planning to deprecate implicit default model selection for the /generate endpoint. Proposal: require an `Accept-Model` header after a 30-day grace. Timeline: canary next week, enforcement in 30 days. Thoughts? :warning:

maria: quick Q — enforcement = 400 if header missing? or fallback to a default model?

alex: enforcement = 400 once enforcement date hits. During the 30-day grace we'll accept missing header and apply an unpinned fallback, but after that requests without `Accept-Model` should fail so clients are forced to pin.

devex: can we provide an SDK opt-in that auto-adds the header while the user migrates? UX needs to be smooth.

tim: agree on SDK helper. also need docs + migration guide. Is a server-side shim possible for older SDKs?

jen: I can own the release notes + migration blog. Also happy to draft customer comms for enterprise customers.

sre-bot: perf/canary scheduled: deploy at 2026-04-20T10:00Z UTC. Alert thresholds: error-rate > 0.5% OR p50 latency increase > 20%.

alex: example request for reviewers:
```http
GET /v1/generate
Accept-Model: redwood-1
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

alex: ping @maria for the compatibility matrix, @devex for SDK flag design. Can reviewers please look at PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/pulls/9876 ? :eyes:

maria: initial matrix draft: SDKs released before 2025-10 get a temporary shim that injects `Accept-Model: redwood-1` for 30 days. SDKs after that must set header explicitly. Need tests for streaming and chunked responses in the shim.

tim: note about streaming: if a request gets routed to a different model variant (e.g., quantized vs float) chunk boundaries might change. Add a note to devdocs and include a regression test.

devex: proposed SDK flag name: `accept_model_auto` (default true until enforcement). Behavior: when true, SDK injects `Accept-Model` based on the current default mapping; it also emits a migration warning in logs.

jen: rollout checklist (draft): 1) canary deploy 2) docs PR + migration guide 3) SDK releases with `accept_model_auto` 4) customer comms + opt-in window 5) enforcement 6) monitor + revert plan.

alex: thanks all. I'll update the PR with the compatibility matrix + checklist. Please ACK or leave review comments by EOD so we can schedule the canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary deploy started (2026-04-20T10:02:03Z)

sre-bot: canary passed (no threshold breaches). Will keep watch for 4h. :white_check_mark:

alex: merging the PR to canary branch now. If anyone sees client-facing errors after the canary, ping this thread and we'll roll back immediately.
